description: Use to compare the average ZUS pension with the average KRUS farmer pension, by year and province. For the latest monthly ZUS pension, use get_pension_stats. Average monthly gross old-age pension from ZUS and average pension and disability benefit of farmers from KRUS (GUS BDL; KRUS figure covers both): yearly since 1999 for Poland and 16 provinces, the latest year-to-date period with the previous year, gap in PLN and KRUS as % of ZUS. For the latest monthly ZUS pension, use get_pension_stats.
name: get_pension_systems
title: Average pension: ZUS vs KRUS
